name: Artemis
summary: Goddess of the hunt, wilderness, and wild animals, and — somewhat paradoxically alongside her vow of eternal virginity — protector of young women and childbirth. Twin sister of Apollo.
domain_role: The hunt, wilderness, wild animals, chastity, childbirth, the moon (in later tradition)
origin_story: Born to Zeus and Leto alongside her twin brother Apollo, Artemis famously asked her father Zeus, while still a child, to grant her eternal virginity and freedom to roam the wilderness with her band of nymph companions, rather than marry.
achievements: Served as protector of young girls and women in childbirth despite her own vow of virginity
Presided over one of the most important cult centers in the Greek world at Ephesus
Fiercely punished mortals who offended her, as in the myth of the hunter Actaeon
Fought on the side of Troy during the Trojan War, alongside her brother Apollo

signature_quote.text: The Homeric Hymn to Artemis emphasizes her role as huntress of the mountains and protector of wild creatures, roaming with her band of nymphs.
